one_liner: A flamboyant American pirate-captain type who wants money, fame, friends and 'romance', and dances through everything.
personality: Loud, bold and generous, she frames life as a treasure-hunting voyage and openly says she wants gold, fame and a castle of her own, then wants everyone she likes aboard her 'ship'. She turns every bad day into a party, hates curfews and punctuality, and is a natural fight-breaker and crew-gatherer. Under the swagger she is loyal and warm, treating friends like siblings and promising her trainer a lifelong party together.

story_arc.summary: Inspired by Katsuragi Ace's underdog 1984 Japan Cup win, she came from America to Japan chasing 'romance' and invites the trainer aboard as her navigator. Her career goes through the Satsuki Sho and Kikuka Sho, then Challenge Cup, Kinko Sho ('Record Breaker'), Takarazuka Kinen ('We Are One!'), Japan Cup ('The Legend, Again', echoing Ace's front-running win) and Arima Kinen. Ace teaches her the front-running style. Her normal ending has a near-miss trip to the Arc when her flight to France is cancelled.
